from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class InvestmentCashFlowRecord(BaseModel):
    """One quarter's investment activity cash flow data from a single financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., '2022 Q1', '2023 Q1')")
    net_cash_flow_investment: float | None = Field(description="Net cash flow from investment activities for this period, in yuan")
    year_over_year_change_percent: float | None = Field(description="Percentage change compared to same period last year")
    reason_for_change: str | None = Field(description="The reason the text gives for the change in cash flow")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text describing the cash flow and reason")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    investment_cash_flow_records: list[InvestmentCashFlowRecord]
